title: Rent, royalty and concession audits in the Controller’s catalogue
question: Which audits checked what tenants owed the City, including tenants that paid correctly or paid too much?
finding: 78 audit titles addressed leases, rent, royalties or concessions. 17 titles mentioned a financial exception; the other reports provide context for interpreting those cases.
how: Search every Audit & Public Integrity Reports title in the saved Controller catalogue for lease, leasing, rent, rental, royalty and concession terms. A second title search labels explicit financial exceptions. The table includes ordinary compliance audits and links directly to the regulator’s reports.
limits: Titles can omit findings inside the report. A report may contain more than one tenant, period or payment adjustment. Underpaid rent, a tenant overpayment and a later collection describe different events. Each dated audit and agency response governs its own amount.
